method: Chromium visited all current sitemap routes in same-origin frames, awaited fonts, checked usable document client width and horizontal scroll width, and compared visible text range rectangles to clipping ancestors. One H1 required on each route.
limitations: Frame layout checks are not exhaustive physical-device testing
DOM text range checks do not prove every glyph pixel is unclipped
New Superdesign proposal is separate from implemented production source
All-route frame audit preceded the consent-specific fixes; the final build and consent-specific real browser checks were rerun afterward
No ranking, traffic, sales or legal-certification claim
